title: Single cell high-throughput qRT-PCR protocol
protocol: Order forward and reverse primers at a stock concentration of 400 µM.
Dilute forward and reverse primers to obtain a mix concentration of 200 µM for pre-amplification step.
Prepare additional working dilutions of 100 µM and 20 µM for forward and reverse primer mixes as needed.
Mix the components for lysis buffer based on the number of samples in the experiment.
For 96 samples with overage for 110 samples: Mix 55 μl of Lysis enhancer (CellDirect kit) with 550 μl of Resuspension buffer (CellDirect kit) for a total volume of 605 μl.
Prepare a 2X or 3X RNA dilution series with 6-8 dilution points.
Calculate the mean sample input to correspond to the middle point in the dilution series.

Mix components for RT Mix immediately before use: For one sample, mix 0.3 μl of 10X Superscript III Mix (VILO kit), 0.2 μl of T4 Gene 32 Protein, and 1 μl of DNA Suspension Buffer to a total volume of 1.5 μl.
For 96 samples with overage for 110 samples, mix 33 μl of 10X Superscript III Mix (VILO kit), 22 μl of T4 Gene 32 Protein, and 110 μl of DNA Suspension Buffer to a total volume of 165 μl.
Store the primer pool at -20°C for up to one year.
Combine 1 μl of each primer in a tube for up to 200 primers.
Bring the volume up to 200 μl with DNA Suspension Buffer for up to 200 primers.
Combine 1 μl of each primer in a tube for more than 200 and up to 400 primers.
Bring the volume up to 400 μl with DNA Suspension Buffer for more than 200 and up to 400 primers.
Mix 88 μl of Exonuclease I reaction buffer 10X with 176 μl of Exonuclease I.
Add 616 μl of DNA Suspension Buffer to the mixture prepared in the previous step.
Ensure the total volume is 880 μl for processing 96 samples with an overage for 110 samples.
Add 5.5 μl lysis buffer to the capture surface on the LCM Cap.
Cover the cap with a 0.2 ml tube and ensure a tight seal.
Incubate at 75°C on a heat block for 15 min.
Cool cap and tube on ice for 5 minutes.
Spin down and transfer cell lysate to PCR tube or plate.
Transfer lysed cells from LCM caps to PCR plate.
Add 4.5 μl of lysis buffer to the samples.
Transfer 1 μl of RNA standard to a single well on the PCR plate and add 4.5 μl of lysis buffer for positive control.
Add 1 μl of molecular grade water to a single well on the PCR plate and add 4.5 μl of lysis buffer for negative control.
Add 1.8 μl of 5X VILO Reaction Mix to each sample.
Spin down samples for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler.
Add 1.5 μl of RT mix to each sample.
Spin down samples for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and proceed to Thermocycler.
Spin down samples for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice.
Store samples overnight at 4°C or store at -20°C for a year (optional).
Add 11.6 μl of PreAmp Mix to each sample on ice.
Spin down samples for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm.
Proceed to Thermocycler for PreAmp22 program.
Spin down samples for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice.
Add 8 μl of Exonuclease Mix to each sample.
Spin down samples for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm.
Proceed to Thermocycler for Exonuclease program.
Spin down samples for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice.
Add 54 μl of TE buffer to each sample.
Prepare Chip Sample plate on the day of Chip run.
For one sample, mix 4 μl of 2X SsoFast EvaGreen Supermix with Low ROX and 0.4 μl of 20X DNA Binding Dye Sample Loading Reagent.
For a 48.48 IFC Biomark chip, prepare a total volume of 242 μl by mixing 220 μl of 2X SsoFast EvaGreen Supermix with Low ROX and 22 μl of 20X DNA Binding Dye Sample Loading Reagent.
For a 96.96 IFC Biomark chip, prepare a total volume of 484 μl by mixing 440 μl of 2X SsoFast EvaGreen Supermix with Low ROX and 44 μl of 20X DNA Binding Dye Sample Loading Reagent.
Aliquot 4.4 μl of the sample mix into each well in a PCR plate following the specified order.
Aliquot 4 μl of 2X Assay Loading Reagent into each well for a 48.48 or 96.96 IFC Biomark chip, based on the layout described in step 1.
Add 4 μl of corresponding primer pairs at 20μM concentration to each well containing the assay loading reagents.
Spin down the plate for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm and place on ice after adding primers.
Inject control line fluid into each accumulator on the BioMark chip as per the IFC Controller MX or HX instructions.
Run the Prime (113x) script for the 48.48 Chip or the Prime (136x) script for the 96.96 Chip to prime and load the BioMark chip.
Press Eject to remove the primed chip from the IFC Controller.
Pipette 5 μL of each assay into their respective inlets on the chip using an 8 channel pipette, loading column 1 (A1, B1..H1) in alternate wells starting with the top left well.

Pipette 5 μL of each sample into their respective inlets on the chip for columns 2 to 6 for a 96.96 chip and columns 2 to 3 for a 48.48 chip, loading starting with second from the top on the seventh column for 96.96 or fourth column for 48.48.
Return the chip to the IFC Controller.
Run the Load Mix (113x) script for the 48.48 Chip or the Load Mix (136x) script for the 96.96 Chip using the IFC Controller software to load samples and assays into the chip chambers.
Remove the loaded chip from the IFC Controller after the script has finished.
Remove any dust particles or debris from the chip surface using scotch tape.
Double-click the Data Collection Software icon on the desktop to launch the software.
Click Start a New Run.
Remove and discard the blue protective film from the bottom of the chip.
Place the chip into the reader.
Click Load.
Verify chip barcode and chip type.
Click Next.
Select New for Chip Run file.
Browse to a file location for data storage.
Click Next.
Select Application Type--Gene Expression for version 3.1.2 or higher software (for all earlier versions, contact Fluidigm Technical Support).
Select Passive Reference: ROX.
Select Probe--Single probe.
Select probe type: EvaGreen.
Click Next.
Click Browse to find the thermal cycling protocol file.
